name: Cala Macarella
description: The definitive postcard of southern Menorca: a horseshoe of white sand, turquoise water and pines down to the shore. Beside it, its little sister, Cala Macarelleta. Serene beauty, best enjoyed early.

practicalInfo.acceso: On foot from Cala Galdana (~30 min along the Camí de Cavalls) or by seasonal bus; car access is restricted in summer
practicalInfo.aparcamiento: From 1 June to 30 September you cannot arrive by car or motorbike: the public car park is closed and the only ways in are the bus, an authorised taxi, a bicycle or on foot. The bus leaves Ciutadella between 8.25am and 8.20pm (every 40 minutes, and every 20 from 15 June); €8.50 return when booked online (half price with the Consell travel card). Outside those dates there is a car park, capacity-controlled, and it fills early.
practicalInfo.servicios: Seasonal beach bar; bring water and shade
practicalInfo.mejorEpoca: In high summer the car is not an option, so the question is not when to park but which bus to catch: the first one, at 8.25am, is the one that gives you the cove almost to yourself. In May and October, when you can still drive up, arrive before 10am.

seo.description: Southern Menorca's most iconic cove: a horseshoe of white sand, turquoise water and pines to the shore, with Cala Macarelleta beside it. Best early.

planner.shuttleInfo: 1 Jun–30 Sep: private cars and motorbikes are banned. Shuttle bus from Ciutadella, licensed taxi, bike or on foot (Camí de Cavalls from Cala Galdana). Off-season: drive to the free car park, 15-20 min walk away.
planner.effortNote: Reached on foot or by shuttle in summer, along the Camí de Cavalls. No reliable services: bring water and shade.
